name: Executive order of August 31, 1869 changing the Niobrara (Santee Sioux) reservation
aka: Approving Secretary of Interior for Santee Sioux changes (1869)
promises: President Grant approved the Interior Secretary's recommendation to restore certain lands of the Santee Sioux reservation to market and withdraw other lands from sale for it.

Royce lists the land restored as fractional townships 31 north, range 6 west; 31 and 32 north, range 7 west; and 31 and 32 north, range 8 west; and the land added as township 31 north, range 4 west and the part of the east half of township 33 north, range 4 west south of the Missouri.
landTaken: The townships Royce lists as restored to the public domain by this order (area 526).

sources.title: Ulysses S. Grant, Executive Order Approving Secretary of Interior for Santee Sioux Changes, August 31, 1869
sources.publisher: The American Presidency Project, UC Santa Barbara

openQuestions: Not a treaty: an executive order exchanging land within a reservation set up by executive order. Under the 2026-11-08 rule this is not by itself a breach.
The ICC title search for "santee" returned only the 1974 Sioux Nation (Black Hills) dockets; no Commission or court finding about this tract was located.
The township list is read from an OCR copy of Royce and should be checked against the page image.
The Santee Sioux Nation's own history of the Niobrara reservation was not found online.
